title: remotion-bits parts
description: remotion-bits (MIT on npm) is a set of Remotion building blocks: text effects, gradient transitions, charts. Installed in your project, a part plays here through a small custom scene.
reasons: not shipped: npm install remotion-bits in your project and wrap the part you want in a custom scene (kind "custom"). The repository has no LICENSE file (package.json says MIT), so read it before you ship.
